operations.summary: Download a conversation attachment to a bounded destination.
operations.description: Help Scout streams the attachment bytes with Content-Disposition and the file's own Content-Type. The sibling .../data endpoint returns base64 inside JSON and is an ordinary read, not a download.
operations.approval: filesystem writes require an explicit destination policy

operations.description: Mailbox API v3 operation. This bundle's base_url is https://api.helpscout.net/v2, so a /v3 path lies outside it: engine.normalizeDirectReadPathForBaseURL only strips a base path the request path actually starts with, so /v3/... is concatenated to the /v2 base and builds .../v2/v3/..., while the runtime operation endpoint ledger separately requires operation.rest.path to equal an api_surface row verbatim. Correct URL construction and ledger membership cannot both hold for an out-of-base path.
operations.approval: not implemented: the direct-read executor lacks a reviewed operation-specific request, output-policy, and CLI contract
